marketed_identity: Astro Tone; Sam Ash Fuzzz Boxx
model_or_product: Astro Tone Fuzz / Sam Ash Fuzzz Boxx
evidence_summary: Astro Amp, also identified as Universal Amplifier Corporation in historical pedal references, is documented as the New York City maker of the Astro Tone Fuzz in 1966-1968. The same product was sold under Sam Ash as the Sam Ash Fuzzz Boxx, establishing a manufacturer-versus-marketed-brand relationship. Preserve Astro Amp as manufacturer and Sam Ash as the retail/marketed identity rather than creating a second builder.
